name: A requeue can still ride past the poll, because the two do not serialise on the PR
description:
Carried out of CZ3TDR1-727 item 10, which is delivered only in part. The stale-head requeue guard and the transition that follows it are now atomic against anything else writing that review row — but not against the poll, which is the race the item was raised for. The rest is a change to the poll's hot path and belongs on its own.

## Why a row lock does not close it

`supersedeOpenPriorReviews` is an `UPDATE` whose predicate excludes `failed` and `rejected`. Under READ COMMITTED it takes locks only on the rows its predicate matches, so a `rejected` row is not one of them: the poll skips it without waiting, whatever the requeue is holding. The inserts for the new head collide with nothing either. Locking the row we are about to move therefore serialises us against every other writer except the one that matters.

## What the remaining window is

From reading the guard to our own `COMMIT` — one database round trip shorter than before this work, and not "two adjacent poll statements", which is how the first review round described it and was wrong.

## What closing it takes

An advisory lock keyed on `(repoId, prNumber)`, taken both in `requeueReviewAction` and in `ensureReviewsForPull`.

`ensureReviewsForPull` cannot take one as it stands: it sends pg-boss jobs between its inserts, so the lock would be held across a queue round trip. Its database work has to move into one transaction with the sends collected and dispatched after the commit.

**That second part is worth doing on its own merits, independently of this race.** As it stands a job can go out for a row that then rolls back.

## Marker in the code

The site carries `TODO(CZ3TDR1-727)` and should be renumbered to this ticket once it exists — `grep TODO(CZ3TDR1-727)` finds two occurrences, this one in `apps/console/lib/actions.ts` (above `requeueReviewAction`) and one more at the sweep in item 7. Check which is which rather than renumbering both.

**Done when:** a requeue and a poll landing on the same PR at the same time cannot both proceed; `ensureReviewsForPull` does its database work in one transaction and sends after the commit; and no marker in the code still points at CZ3TDR1-727 for work that lives here.
